overview_description.description:
Datrics develops and offers an advanced AI platform and AI Analyst designed to enhance data processing and analytics for businesses. Our secure toolkit utilizes cutting-edge AI technology to learn unique terminologies, workflows, and metrics, delivering instant actionable insights tailored for specific business applications.

Our primary use cases include insurance claims processing, recruitment and hiring, financial planning and analysis, and a CFO Copilot focused on answering critical questions regarding unit economics and profits. 

Datrics also provides the Text2SQL framework, which simplifies converting plain language questions into precise SQL queries without coding.

We cater to organizations of all sizes, ensuring our solutions seamlessly integrate into existing infrastructures while automating the generation of insights and reports. Our mission is to transform how businesses harness the power of data, making advanced analytics accessible to every team and driving growth in today's data-driven landscape.

about_short_description.short_description: Datrics is an AI-powered Analytics platform to help users explore data, generate insights and automate routines 10x faster.

product.name: Datrics AI Platform
product.description: A data intelligence platform that enables users to create custom data pipelines, perform automated data preparation, and build advanced models using a no-code visual interface.

product.name: Datrics AI Analyst
product.description: A natural language interface that allows users to query and analyze data instantly, embedded within workflows and capable of scheduled insights across multiple data sources.

product.name: Professional Services
product.description: Consulting and support services including data science, data analysis, engineering, bespoke model development, and ongoing AI program assistance.

product.name: Embedded Solution (API-First Architecture)
product.description: An API-driven solution that allows integration of Datrics' AI-powered analytics directly into existing applications with customization and branding control.

product.name: Cloud Platform
product.description: A secure hosted environment providing access to the full range of Datrics' analytics and AI features without on-premise infrastructure requirements.

product.name: On-Premise Deployment
product.description: An installation option that allows organizations to deploy Datrics within their own secure environment to meet strict compliance and security requirements.
